description: 21 viewers on one page exceeded Chrome's ~16 WebGL context cap, silently killing the first-created five (carvone pair + cannabinoid trio). Fix per Denson: split into two pages - index.html keeps the terpene/flavorant atlas (16 viewers), new page carries the same-atoms concept story (chips, twins, mirror twist, hinge, cannabinoid trio, entourage; 5 viewers) with its figures. Also keeping viewport-based viewer create/release (LIVE map, WEBGL_lose_context) since mobile GPUs cap at ~8. gen_mirrors.py learns the new page; llms.txt/start.md/sitemap/cross-links updated.

comments.text: Follow-up d46ee01: the generator patch in 91c8b04 had silently half-applied - same-atoms.md was never written (mirror 404'd live while the page served; caught by post-deploy verification). Fixed with verifiable edits: same-atoms.md/.txt now carry the page prose + chiral/cannabinoid data + the delta-8 appendix; index.md carries only its own page; full corpus concatenates all three.

title: Split index into two pages: aroma atlas + same-atoms story (WebGL context cap broke viewers)
